brief:
The anti-Netanyahu parliamentary bloc holds decisive influence over the election of a new Knesset speaker, Al Jazeera English reported. With no single coalition commanding an outright majority, opposition parties can shape the outcome and potentially shift parliamentary momentum.

The speaker's election reflects the fractured state of Israeli politics, where smaller factions wield outsized power in Knesset proceedings. Control of the speakership could affect legislative scheduling, committee assignments, and procedural advantages for the opposition.
dek: The anti-Netanyahu bloc holds the keys to electing a new parliamentary speaker, setting the momentum for change.
title: Opposition bloc gains leverage in Israeli speaker election
